stories.subTitle: South Africa in Sri Lanka 2013
stories.seoTitle: Faf better than AB, but no third option
stories.summary: While Faf du Plessis' captaincy was more confident than AB de Villiers' in Sri Lanka, South Africa have not invested in grooming a leader during a decade of Graeme Smith and are left with little choice beyond the two
